name: The Irvine Spectrum Center
description: The Irvine Spectrum Center is Orange County's premier open-air lifestyle destination featuring over 130 stores and restaurants, iconic attractions including a Giant Wheel and carousel, and year-round entertainment. Celebrating 30 years of serving the community, this upscale center combines high-end retail with diverse dining options and family-friendly attractions in a vibrant outdoor setting. The center hosts seasonal events, live music, an ice rink, and creates memorable experiences for visitors of all ages.
demographics: Affluent families and young professionals in Orange County, California seeking upscale shopping, dining, and entertainment experiences
summary: Southern California's iconic open-air lifestyle center combining upscale shopping, acclaimed dining, and unique entertainment attractions including a Giant Wheel and seasonal ice rink.
